one_line: Founder of the Varman dynasty ruling frontier Kamarupa along the Brahmaputra in the age of Samudragupta.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, athletic-medium build, with the steady bearing of an early frontier king.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown Assamese complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache framing a calm but alert default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a medium-height topknot at the back of the crown, sides combed smooth; a narrow gold headband with a small central leaf-shaped ornament rests above the forehead, and a simple dark cloth band ties the base of the knot.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early Gupta-period royal attire adapted to the humid Brahmaputra valley: a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, worn over a wrapped lower garment (dhoti-style) in deep forest green with a gold stripe along the hem, pleated in front and tied at the waist; over this, a light mustard-gold cotton-angavastra shawl with thin red edging drapes from the left shoulder across the torso and around the right arm; he wears a narrow brown leather belt with a small metal clasp, simple gold stud earrings, a single medium-width gold armlet on the right upper arm, and plain brown leather sandals suited for riverbank terrain.
appearance.signature: A straight, single-edged iron sword with a slightly widening tip, a simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, and no guard, carried sheathed in a plain brown scabbard hanging from his belt at the left hip.

ref_desc: Pushyavarman has a medium-brown Assamese complexion, oval face with short beard, black hair in a topknot under a gold headband, wearing an off-white tunic, forest-green wrapped dhoti, mustard-gold shawl, brown belt and sandals, and carrying a plain single-edged iron sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Pushyavarman, founder of the Varman dynasty of Kamarupa: a late-30s, athletic medium-build man with a medium-brown Assamese complexion, oval face, high cheekbones, straight nose, sharp dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his thick black hair gathered in a medium-height topknot at the back of the crown with sides combed smooth, a narrow gold headband with a small central leaf-shaped ornament resting above his forehead and a simple dark cloth band tying the base of the knot. Dress him in early Gupta-period, Brahmaputra-valley appropriate royal clothing: a modest knee-length off-white cotton tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, over a wrapped dhoti-style lower garment in deep forest green with a gold stripe along the hem, pleated in front and tied at the waist, and a light mustard-gold cotton shawl with thin red edging (angavastra) draped from his left shoulder across the torso and around the right arm. Add a narrow brown leather belt with a small metal clasp, simple gold stud earrings, a single medium-width gold armlet on the right upper arm, and plain brown leather sandals. His signature weapon is a straight, single-edged iron sword with a slightly widening tip, a simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather and no guard, in a plain brown scabbard hanging from his belt at the left hip. Use a palette dominated by off-white, forest green, mustard-gold, brown leather and deep red accents, and present him in neutral front, side and three-quarter poses to show face, topknot, garments and sword clearly.
